My research and analytical work spans peacebuilding, post-war political economy, security sector reform, and risk forecasting. This page lists selected publications and major institutional projects. Institutional reports are collective products; my role is noted where it was substantial.

## Peer-reviewed and academic

Jourde (eds.), [*Islamism and Social Movements in North Africa, the Sahel and Beyond: Transregional and Local Perspectives*](https://www.routledge.com/Islamism-and-Social-Movements-in-North-Africa-the-Sahel-and-Beyond-Transregional/Campana-Jourde/p/book/9781315143576) (Routledge, 2018).
